prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of MAAT, Egyptian goddess personifying truth, cosmic order and justice.
ANATOMY: one young adult human woman, one head, two human arms and hands, two legs, wingless selected variant. One large single ostrich feather upright in her headband; completely opaque ivory linen gown. A huge balanced judgment scale directly before her, one pan containing a feather and the other a closed opaque vessel symbolizing the heart, no actual organ. [maat-c09, maat-c06, maat-c07]
MOMENT: lean forward and lower the immense balanced scale toward the viewer as she judges a soul; fingers hold the upright scale shaft securely, the other hand extends in an authoritative verdict. Severe compassionate concentrated gaze looks directly downward at the viewer. Her face, feather and scales occupy nearly the whole square.
POWER: behind her, the stars form vast orderly celestial arcs, visualizing her documented regulation of stars, with no emitted beams or generic glow. [maat-c02] The massive scales weigh the soul in the Duat. [maat-c06, maat-c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme worm's-eye viewpoint directly below the balance; close framing with foreshortened hands and scale pans projecting into the foreground; apparent monumental sacred presence, no claim of literal giant height.
LIGHT & WEATHER: a single warm low lamp outside the frame casts hard antique gold light up onto the scales and face, deep walnut shadows, faint natural dust.
SURFACE: weighted rough-woven linen, tarnished heavy bronze scales, distinct individual ostrich feather barbs, human skin.
SETTING: dark Duat judgment space beneath the ordered stars, bare rock ground, no invented creatures or additional people. [maat-c06, maat-c02]
MOOD: awe-inspiring and imposing guardian of justice; judgment feels unavoidable, never a decorative portrait or an ordinary passerby.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, hieroglyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark; exactly one head and two human arms; no wings; no extra limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Wingless feather-bearing young Maat delivering judgment through a foreground bronze balance.

visual_requirements.description: Young human woman wearing one ostrich feather; wingless selected alternative, fully opaque linen editorial clothing.
Large balance with feather and opaque symbolic heart vessel.
Ordered stars behind her representing regulation of stars, no new attack.

aura: Inevitable judgment through the huge scales and ordered stars (maat-c06/c07/c02), no luminous body aura.
artistic_choices: Monumental presence is close low-angle framing and foreshortening, not literal giant anatomy.
Bronze scales, opaque symbolic heart vessel, dark bare Duat staging, linen and lamp illumination are editorial.
Stars visualize cosmic order, not emitted magic.

visual_review.notes: Native PNG inspected: dominant wingless young goddess, one head two human arms, explicit single head feather, both scale pans clear with feather and sealed vessel; central lower disc is balance stand base. Foreshortened reaching verdict hand and frontal scale provide judgment action and imposing thumbnail silhouette. Ordered star arcs, warm lamp light, textured bronze and opaque linen, no emitted beams or extra anatomy, no lettering or watermark. All seven Uji Sangar checks yes.

rejected_attempts.reason: Separate shoulder wings did not match c09 exact arm-wing anatomy. Selected wingless feather variant instead.
Ordinary woman with scales at human scale.

rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

root_visual_review.notes: Maat with ostrich feather behind a huge foreground balance holding feather and sealed vessel, ordered stars above; imposing judgment scene.
